title: Add shared-store and cross-platform handoff smoke coverage
description: Add storage integration coverage proving two projects configured with the same wtpDir observe the same global/task handoff collection, while legacy stores without handoffs.json initialize and read cleanly. Exercise write, get, claim attachment, purge, and export through the installed-style CLI process. Extend both Unix and PowerShell smoke scripts with a minimal handoff round trip using platform-safe quoting and cleanup.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected task and repository guidance. Existing handoff implementation and unit/export coverage are present; this task still needs installed-style process coverage for shared wtpDir visibility, legacy stores without handoffs.json, write/get/claim/purge/export, plus Unix and PowerShell smoke round trips.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented CLI-process integration coverage for shared absolute wtpDir handoffs and legacy stores missing handoffs.json. Coverage exercises write, global/task get, task claim attachment, purge visibility across projects, and export; Unix and PowerShell smoke scripts now run a quoted write/get/purge round trip with fixture cleanup. Verified with go test ./..., both smoke scripts, git diff --check, ./scripts/verify.sh commit, and pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/verify.ps1 commit.
